title: Intercostal Cryoanalgesia in Double Lung Transplant Recipients
official: Intercostal Cryoanalgesia in Double Lung Transplant Recipients
summary: This study is testing a new way to help manage pain after a double lung transplant. Instead of relying only on strong pain medicines like opioids, doctors will use a cold-therapy probe during surgery to help numb the nerves near the incision. Researchers want to see if this method can reduce the need for opioids and improve recovery.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Adults ≥18 years of age
* Undergoing double lung transplantation via bilateral thoracotomies or clamshell incision

Exclusion Criteria:

* Multi-organ transplant recipients
* Redo lung transplant recipients
